unlockPhases.goal: Monetize current traffic with already-active partners
Broaden activities and transport after traffic proves out
Add niche travel utilities only when demand exists

note: ActiveNow is canonical from data/affiliate-partners.json; futureUnlock is derived from owner-visible but not yet unlocked Travelpayouts programs.

ownerEvidence.source: Owner screenshots of Travelpayouts program catalog
ownerEvidence.conclusion: Desired programs are visible, but many remain locked/not active for ERN; traffic growth is the gating strategy.

recheckSignals.signal: Travelpayouts explicitly changes a program to usable/approved or exposes link-generation controls
ERN records its first eligible affiliate conversion/revenue
Commercial outbound clicks become sustained across multiple destinations rather than isolated owner/testing activity
Search/discovery traffic grows materially from the current soft-launch baseline
Owner chooses to inspect program status for another reason

recheckRule: Do not recheck traffic-gated programs on a calendar cadence. Recheck only when at least one direct/strong signal occurs, or when the owner voluntarily opens the account.
nearTermBusinessPriority: Expand exact destination links with currently active Viator/Klook/Tiqets/Welcome Pickups
Bundle owner-only exact-link generation sessions instead of interrupting one place at a time
Use currently link-generation-capable Travelpayouts utilities only where they solve a real visitor need
Grow qualified visitor/search traffic so stay programs such as Trip.com, Hotels.com, Booking.com, Agoda and Expedia can unlock later
firstProgramReason: Trip.com combines global accommodation with transport/activity breadth, directly addressing ERN's stay gap while serving many of the existing 287 searchable places.
